(Firaakshinii hin-gabaabaaf barreessi. Lakkoofsa guutuu yoo ta'e lakkoofsaan barreessi. Fkn: 3/4)
hints: Dura $E(X)$ fi $E(X^{2})$ argadhu.

stat_ciMean.prompt: Maatii baay'ina akka waliigalaa (population) raabsiinsa seera aadaa (normal) hordofu keessaa {cnt} carraa tiin filatame. Giddu-galeessi fakkeenyaa $\bar{x}={xbar}$ fi jallina maatii $\sigma={sig}$ dha. Daangaa amanamummaa ${cl}\%$ tiin giddu-galeessa maatii $\bar{x}-z\dfrac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}\le m\le\bar{x}+z\dfrac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}$ dha, kanaan gatiin $z$ ${z}$ dha. Xumura olii (gatii olii) daangaa kanaa meeqa? (Lakkoofsa qofa barreessi)
hints: Dura dogoggora istaandaardii (standard error) $\dfrac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}$ argadhu. $n$ lakkoofsa sirrii (square) waan ta'eef sirriitti hirama.
Daangaan dogoggoraa $z\times$(dogoggora istaandaardii) dha; gatiin olii $\bar{x}$ irratti kana dabaluu dha.
stat_ciMean.explanation: Dogoggorri istaandaardii $\frac{{sig}}{\sqrt{{cnt}}}={se}$, daangaan dogoggoraa ${z}\times{se}={moe}$ waan ta'eef gatiin olii ${xbar}+{moe}={ans}$ dha.

stat_ciProp.prompt: Imaammata tokkoo ilaalchisee namoota {cnt} carraa tiin filatanii yoo qoratame {ag} deeggaruu isaanii mirkaneessan. Hanga fakkeenyaa $\hat{p}$ yoo jedhame daangaa amanamummaa ${cl}\%$ hanga maatii $\hat{p}-z\sqrt{\dfrac{\hat{p}(1-\hat{p})}{n}}\le p\le\hat{p}+z\sqrt{\dfrac{\hat{p}(1-\hat{p})}{n}}$ dha, kanaan gatiin $z$ ${z}$ dha. Gatii olii daangaa kanaa dhibbeentaa (%) tiin yoo ibsame meeqa? (Lakkoofsa qofa barreessi)
hints: Dura hanga fakkeenyaa $\hat{p}=\dfrac{{ag}}{{cnt}}$ argadhu.
$\sqrt{\dfrac{\hat{p}(1-\hat{p})}{n}}$ lakkoofsa ibsamu (rational) tiin sirriitti hirama. Dhibbeentaatti jijjiirtee yoo herregte salphaa dha.
stat_ciProp.explanation: $\hat{p}={ph}\%$, $\sqrt{\frac{\hat{p}(1-\hat{p})}{{cnt}}}={sdp}\%$ waan ta'eef daangaan dogoggoraa ${z}\times{sdp}={moe}$(%) dha; gatiin olii ${ph}+{moe}={ans}$(%) dha.

stat_linReverse.prompt: Jijjiiramaa $x$ irraa jijjiiramaa haaraa $y$ tolchame ($y={eq}$). Giddu-galeessi $y$ ${my}$, jallinni ${sy}$ ture. Jallinni jijjiiramaa $x$ meeqa? (Lakkoofsa qofa barreessi)
hints: $y=ax+b$ yoo ta'e jallinni (standard deviation) al $|a|$ ta'a.
Dhaabbataan itti dabalame $b$ fi giddu-galeessi jallina wajjin hidhata hin qaban. Jallina $y$ $|a|$ tiin hiri.
stat_linReverse.explanation: Gatiin dhiifamaa qooda $x$ ${aa}$ waan ta'eef jallinni $y$ jallina $x$ al ${aa}$ dha. Kanaaf jallinni $x$ ${sy}\div{aa}={ans}$ dha.

stat_linTransform.prompt: Giddu-galeessi jijjiiramaa $x$ ${m}$, garaa-garummaan (variance) ${vx}$ dha. Jijjiiramaan haaraa $y$ $y={eq}$ yoo ta'e garaa-garummaan $y$ meeqa? (Lakkoofsa qofa barreessi)
hints: $y=ax+b$ yoo ta'e garaa-garummaan al $a^2$ ta'a.
Dhaabbataan itti dabalamu $b$ hanga facaasuu hin jijjiiru, kanaaf garaa-garummaa irratti dhiibbaa hin qabu.
stat_linTransform.explanation: $y={eq}$ keessatti qooda $x$ ${ap}$ waan ta'eef garaa-garummaan ${vx}\times{ap}^{2}={vx}\times{a2}={ans}$ dha (dhaabbataa fi giddu-galeessi garaa-garummaa irratti dhiibbaa hin qaban).

stat_quartileIqr.prompt: Odeeffannoo {data} guddina isaatiin tarreessanii booda giddu-galeessa gidduu galeessa irraa kutaa gadii keessa jiru quartile jalqabaa $Q_1$, giddu-galeessa kutaa olii $Q_3$ (quartile sadaffaa) jedhama. (Lakkoofsi odeeffannoo gaarii yoo ta'e giddu-galeessi of isaa kutaa lamaan keessaa kamittuu hin kaa'amu.) Daangaan quartile $Q_3-Q_1$ gatiin isaa meeqa? (Lakkoofsa qofa barreessi)
hints: Dura odeeffannoo gatii xiqqaa irraa jalqabii guddina isaatiin deebi'ii barreessi.
Giddu-galeessa waliigalaa irraa odeeffannoo kutaa gadii fi olii tti qoodii, giddu-galeessa kutaa tokko tokkoo argadhu.

stat_rejectN.prompt: Hypothesis itti aanu qoratama. $H_0: m={mu0}$, $H_1: m>{mu0}$. Standard deviation population $\sigma={sig}$ fi giddugaleessi fakkeenya $\bar{x}={xbar}$ jedhame yaadama. Statistic qorannoo $Z=\dfrac{\bar{x}-{mu0}}{\sigma/\sqrt{n}}$ ${crit}$ caalaa yoo guddatu null hypothesis ni didama. Giddugaleessi fakkeenya wal-fakkaatu yoo argame, null hypothesis akka didamu kan godhu bal'ina fakkeenyaa $n$ isa xiqqaa meeqa? (lakkoofsa uumamaa, lakkoofsa qofa barreessi)
hints: Inequality itti aanu bifa $\sqrt{n}$ irratti godhii jijjiiri. $Z>{crit}$
Gama lamaan square godhii daangaa $n$ argadhu; haala guutu lakkoofsa uumamaa isa xiqqaa barbaadi. Wal-qixxummaan didaa miti.
stat_rejectN.explanation: $Z=\dfrac{{xbar}-{mu0}}{{sig}}\sqrt{n}>{crit}$ irraa $\sqrt{n}>{rt}$, jechuunis $n>{lim}$ (gatii iddoo aanaa lammaffaatti agarsiifame) dha. Lakkoofsi uumamaa isa xiqqaa kana guutu ${ans}$ dha.

stat_sdFreq.prompt: Gatiin variable $x$ {xs} fi baay'ina gatii tokkoon tokkoo tartiibaan {fs} kan ta'e gabatee baay'ina (frequency table) jira. Data kana akka population guutuutti ilaalamee (hiramaan variance ida'ama baay'ina dha) standard deviation yoo argame meeqa? (lakkoofsa qofa barreessi)
hints: Ida'ama baay'ina $N$ fi giddugaleessa $m=\dfrac{\sum f x}{N}$ dura argadhu.
Variance $=\dfrac{\sum f x^2}{N}-m^2$ dha; standard deviation hundee square positive isaati.
stat_sdFreq.explanation: $N={tot}$, giddugaleessa $m={mean}$, $\dfrac{\sum f x^2}{N}={msq}$ waan ta'eef variance ${var}$ dha; standard deviation ${ans}$ dha.

stat_stratified.prompt: Ijoolleen baay'inni isaanii {n1}, {n2}, {n3} kan ta'e kutaa sadii keessaa waliigalatti {ns} stratified sampling godhuu barbaanna. Kutaa (stratum) tokkoon tokkoon keessaa saffisa baay'ina barattootaa waliigalaa irraa kutaa sanaa wajjin wal-simsiisuun proportional allocation yoo godhame, kutaa {i}ffaa irraa barattoota hanga meeqa filachuu? (lakkoofsa qofa barreessi)
hints: Dura baay'ina barattootaa waliigalaa $N$ argadhu.
Hanga kutaa {i}ffaa irraa filatamu (baay'ina barattootaa filatamaa waliigalaa)$\times\dfrac{{ni}}{N}$ dha.
stat_stratified.explanation: Baay'inni barattootaa waliigalaa ${pop}$ waan ta'eef ${ns}\times\dfrac{{ni}}{{pop}}={ans}$ dha.

stat_tCiLower.prompt: Population normal distribution hordofu irraa fakkeenya {cnt} carraan fudhatame. Giddugaleessi fakkeenya $\bar{x}={xbar}$, standard deviation fakkeenya $s={sd}$ dha. Standard deviation population waan hin beekamneef $t$ distribution fayyadama; gabatee $t$ distribution degrees of freedom ${df}$ irraa $P(T\le {t0})=0.975$ dha. Giddugaleessa $m$ confidence $95\%$ confidence interval $\bar{x}-t_0\dfrac{s}{\sqrt{n}}\le m\le\bar{x}+t_0\dfrac{s}{\sqrt{n}}$ ($t_0={t0}$) fiixee gadi-aanaa (daangaa gadii) meeqa? (lakkoofsa qofa barreessi)
hints: Degrees of freedom $n-1$ dha; standard error $\dfrac{s}{\sqrt{n}}$ dha.
Daangaan gadii $\bar{x}-t_0\times$(standard error) dha.
stat_tCiLower.explanation: Standard error $\frac{{sd}}{\sqrt{{cnt}}}={se}$, margin of error ${t0}\times{se}={moe}$ waan ta'eef daangaan gadii ${xbar}-{moe}={ans}$ dha.

stat_zStat.prompt: Umurii giddugaleessaa mi'a tokkoo ${mu0}$ sa'aatii akka ta'e beekama. Karoora haaraa tiin mi'a {cnt} carraan fudhatamee yoo qoratame umurii giddugaleessaa $\bar{x}={xbar}$ sa'aatii ture. Umurii normal distribution hordofee fi standard deviation population $\sigma={sig}$ sa'aatii akka hin jijjiiramne yoo ta'e, null hypothesis $H_0: m={mu0}$ ilaalchisee gatiin statistic qorannoo $Z=\dfrac{\bar{x}-{mu0}}{\sigma/\sqrt{n}}$ meeqa? (lakkoofsa qofa barreessi)
hints: Dura $\dfrac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}$ shallagi.
Garaagarummaa giddugaleessa fakkeenya fi ${mu0}$ gatii kanaan qoodi. Negative ta'uu danda'a.
